```js
await page.evaluate('async () => {\n  const deadline=Date.now()+3000;while(vm.runtime.getTargetForStage().variables.var_steps.value!==1&&Date.now()<deadline)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,16));\n  const t=vm.runtime.targets.find(t=>t.getName()===\'Harness Robot\'),v=vm.runtime.getTargetForStage().variables;\n  if(t.x!==10||t.y!==0||v.var_steps.value!==1||v.var_ready.value!==1)throw Error(\'Reload regression failed\');\n  if(window.__nativeErrors.length)throw Error(\'Page or compilation errors found\');\n  return {x:t.x,y:t.y,steps:v.var_steps.value,ready:v.var_ready.value,errors:window.__nativeErrors};\n}');
```
